title: Lumineth [Abandoned]
description: A Datapack in which you start on a brand new dimension to explore from cero! A whole new world with new mechanics, structures, items and mobs!
body:
# Lumineth
Enter a fantastic new world with new structures to explore, new mobs to kill, new items to discover, new weapons, food and mechanics to try.

## Important
- Lumineth requires a [**Resource Pack**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lums-resource-pack) for all items, weapons and mobs.
- At the moment it is not made for compatibility with other datapacks.
- do **NOT** add it to your existing worlds - Create a new world.
- The world will always be generated with amplified terrain.
